summary.text: The combination applies direct preference optimization to improve code generation and instruction-following capabilities in language models. Specifically, consensus-driven direct preference optimization weights preference pairs by their behavioral consensus to mitigate noisy self-generated supervision and improve code generation without external supervision. This addresses limitations where preference optimization methods often rely on costly external resources such as superior teacher models or test oracles, and suffer from noisy self-generated supervision.

value_prop.text: Consensus-driven direct preference optimization weights each preference pair by its behavioral consensus, thereby mitigating the impact of noisy self-generated supervision and improving code generation without external supervision.
